# infra/.github/workflows — Documentation Mirror

The **active** GitHub Actions workflows live at the repository root in
`.github/workflows/` (the path GitHub requires).

This directory mirrors `.github/workflows/` for **ADR coherence** with
`infra/` as the infrastructure-as-code namespace.

Files reference (do not edit here):
- `ci.yml`           → root `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `test.yml`         → root `.github/workflows/test.yml`
- `tofu-validate.yml`→ root `.github/workflows/tofu-validate.yml`

Single source of truth: **root `.github/workflows/`**.
